commitResults.messageBody: Extract task command parsing and stored-task decoding into dedicated classes to keep Parser and Storage focused.

commitResults.messageBody: Return command responses as strings so the GUI and console share the existing parser, task list, and storage behavior. Add responsive styling and tests for the shared response flow.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge Level 10 graphical user interface
commitResults.messageBody: Integrate the verified JavaFX interface while retaining the feature branch and shared console behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: fix method names for clarity
Reject Non-Positive Task Numbers in TaskList
commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList assumes User will always provide a positive task number when deleting or marking a task as done. Calls with negative numbers might bypass KojisPawnException.

This change helps to validate that the correct task number is provided by the user and throws a KojisPawnException if the task number is non-positive.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add assertions to document important assumptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Important assumptions about command data and GUI initialization are
implicit. If future changes violate them, failures can surface later and
be harder to diagnose.

Add assertions to document these invariants and detect programming errors
closer to their source when assertion checking is enabled.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove obsolete UI display methods
commitResults.messageBody:
With the GUI changes, these methods are obsolete.
Thus they will be removed to avoid clutter and
confusion. This is to improve readability of code.

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplify command execution flow
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, the command execution flow was a bit
convoluted, with multiple layers of method calls
and checks.

This refactor simplifies the process by
streamlining the command execution path, making it
 easier to follow and maintain.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use streams when loading stored tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
The previous implementation with accumulator loop
is not as clear as having a stream.

This helps to improve both readability.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add one-level undo for task changes
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot recover from an accidental task mutation without manually reversing it.

Store an independent snapshot before each successful add, delete, mark, or unmark. Add the undo command to restore and persist that snapshot while leaving read-only and failed commands out of history. Cover parsing, copying, persistence, and console flows with tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge C-Undo task history extension
Preserve task state when saving fails
commitResults.messageBody:
Task changes currently reach the live list before saving succeeds, so a
write failure leaves tasks and undo history inconsistent.

Save an independent candidate before adopting it. Keep failed undo
attempts retryable and document the task-copy contract. Add JUnit
coverage for failed add, mark, unmark, delete, and undo operations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Validate saved task records before loading
commitResults.messageBody:
Malformed records can raise unchecked exceptions or silently lose fields
when the stored data does not match the expected format.

Validate field counts, task types, completion flags, and date values.
Report the file and physical line number without changing saved data.
Add JUnit coverage for malformed records and blank lines.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject unsafe task text and simplify parsing
commitResults.messageBody:
Task text containing storage separators can corrupt saved records. Event
parsing also repeats marker and value validation.

Reject reserved separators and line breaks, extract shared validation
helpers, and explain whitespace checks. Add parser regression tests and
a console recovery case while retaining existing error messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract delayed exit from the chat input handler
commitResults.messageBody:
The input handler mixes chat coordination with animation timer setup,
making its steps operate at different levels of detail.

Move the farewell delay into scheduleExit while preserving the existing
one-second pause before closing the application.

commitResults.messageTitle: Style JavaFX chat with Cinzel and midnight gold
commitResults.messageBody: Bundle the open-licensed Cinzel font and add a gold pawn header so the theme renders consistently across machines. Restyle chat bubbles and command controls to match the darker palette while keeping console command behavior unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Koji's Pawn personality with custom avatars
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the starter JavaFX UI's stock portraits with Koji's mask and a
simple user stickman. The custom icons make the chat feel original and
better express Koji's personality, while their smaller size leaves more
room for messages. Keep the pawn as the window icon and include the
generator for the drawn icons.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand JUnit coverage for commands and storage failures
commitResults.messageBody:
Add tests for search and task-change responses, console formatting,
parser errors, and unreadable storage paths. These cases verify
behavior that was previously checked only indirectly and make future
error-handling changes safer to review.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle duplicate task markers, EOF, and load errors
commitResults.messageBody:
Reject repeated /by, /from, and /to markers so malformed task
commands cannot silently become saved values. Exit cleanly when
console input ends, and show storage load errors in a JavaFX alert
so users can understand startup failures.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge A-Personality into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Give Koji's Pawn its own voice and visual identity with Cinzel,
midnight gold, and custom chat avatars to distinguish it from
the starter JavaFX interface.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge A-MoreTesting into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Add focused JUnit coverage for command parsing, task state,
storage failures, and response formatting to catch regressions
that the earlier tests did not cover.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge A-MoreErrorHandling into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Reject repeated task parameters, exit cleanly when console input
ends, and explain storage load failures in the JavaFX interface.
These changes make common user and environment errors actionable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject events with reversed or impossible ISO dates
commitResults.messageBody:
Event start and end values remain free-form, but leading ISO
calendar dates can be checked reliably. Validate those dates
before saving so an event cannot end before it starts, while
preserving existing time-only input.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update user guide with current features and screenshot
commitResults.messageBody:
Document JavaFX chat, undo, event date validation, and common
errors so the product guide reflects current behavior. Use
realistic example tasks, show the full GUI screenshot, and
clarify the starter template's Duke origin in the root README.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge event-date validation and user guide into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Prevent reversed ISO event dates and publish the updated product
guide with realistic examples and a full JavaFX screenshot.
Keep the template's Duke origin clear while using Koji's Pawn
as the visible product name.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep user guide focused on chatbot usage
commitResults.messageBody:
Remove the JavaFX appearance notes and project check commands.
Readers need command syntax, examples, and task behavior; the
developer details distract from those instructions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Guide users through JAR startup and task numbers
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide only explains source-based startup, so someone with the
fat JAR cannot see how to launch the GUI. Add the JAR command and
make the task-data location and changing task numbers clear.

Remove the technical storage-error section to keep the guide
focused on commands users can act on.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge A-UserGuide into master
Simplify user guide startup for released JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need a short path from downloading the JAR to launching
the chat. Replace source-code and console setup with numbered
steps for Java 25, a dedicated folder, and the JAR command.

Keep the task-file location and farewell behavior clear for
someone using the JavaFX window.

commitResults.messageTitle: Explain input errors and event date order
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need to know which mistakes leave tasks unchanged and how
dated events are validated. Summarize common command errors and
clarify that an event can end on its start date or a later date.

commitResults.messageTitle: Show greeting when JavaFX starts
commitResults.messageBody:
The JavaFX window opens with an empty conversation even though the
console interface has an introduction.

Show the disclaimer and greeting as the first Koji response so users
receive the same introduction in both interfaces. Keep the banner in
the source without displaying it, and update tests and documentation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document Apple Silicon Java requirement
commitResults.messageBody:
Apple Silicon users need a Java distribution that includes JavaFX.

Document the required Zulu build and verification command so the
packaged application starts with the correct runtime.

commitResults.messageTitle: Prevent blank messages in chat window
commitResults.messageBody:
Ignore empty and whitespace-only submissions so pressing Enter without
a command does not add chat bubbles or trigger a response.
Add focused tests for blank and valid input detection.
